facts.fact: 一只被野兽袭击的火貂被送进诊所。
facts.anchor: When a fae stumbled into my clinic with blood covering her clothes, cradling a fire ferret

facts.fact: Micah 与 Elowen 抢救失败，火貂死亡。
Lucan 在酒馆陪伴失意的 Micah。
facts.anchor: “Was walking through town and saw you sitting here alone. Looked like you needed some company.”

facts.fact: 借酒消愁的 Micah 自责不是好兽医。
facts.anchor: “I lost a patient.” The words come out thick and slurred.

facts.fact: Lucan 安慰 Micah，让他想想救活的病人。
facts.anchor: “You’re too hard on yourself,” Lucan insists, squeezing my shoulder.

facts.fact: Lucan 拿走酒杯，说人类酒量不如巨人。
facts.anchor: Humans can’t handle their booze like us giants.

facts.fact: Micah 摔倒后 Lucan 决定送他回铁匠铺住所过夜。
Lucan 把 Micah 抱上楼梯。
facts.anchor: He scoops me up easily into his arms.

facts.fact: Lucan 让出自己的床，自己睡沙发。
facts.anchor: “You can take my bed,” he says as we reach the landing.

facts.fact: Micah 穿着 Lucan 的旧上衣入睡。
